text:
maria: Quick sync: packaging pipeline flagged missing component tag in release_notes.md for private/VPC installer 1.4.3. Two options: pause and fix now, or ship installer and deliver corrected notes as a signed sidecar. Thoughts? :warning:

packaging-bot: Packaging pipeline: artifact built, manifest generated, but release-notes validator failed: missing tag `security-policy`. Build artifact path: gs://staging-artifacts/private/1.4.3/installer-1.4.3.tar.gz

sam: If it's strictly metadata (notes only) we could ship binary and add sidecar, but compliance might reject. Time delta for an autofix+rebuild+resign?

maria: Autofix script exists. Rough estimate: autofix + rebuild ~20m, cosign sign + escrow push ~6m. Total ~26-30m depending on queue.

jordan: Who are the compliance customers that require embedded notes? Need quick list before deciding sidecar.

elaine: Compliance check: contracts with embedded-release-notes clause: acme-corp, healthco, medsys. If we sidecar, we need to notify them and get explicit ack. That could exceed window.

ops: Technical constraints: once installer blob is cosign-signed, you cannot mutate it. Sidecar approach is allowed if contract doesn't mandate embedding. Sidecar will be cosign-signed and escrowed under s3://redwood-escrow/private/1.4.3/release-notes-sidecar.sig. For embedded change we'd rebuild and re-sign entire bundle.

rei: If we delay ~30m we preserve contract guarantees for those customers and keep artifact tidy. Rollback plan: canary window 22:00-22:20, full rollout 22:20-23:00. Proposal: only proceed to canary if: API error rate <2% over 5m, median token latency regression <100ms, KV warmup miss rate <12% after 5m. Any violation -> immediate rollback to 1.4.2 pinned.

ben: Add: packaging-agent checks on downstream registries. If >=2 customers report manifest checksum mismatch during canary, abort. Also watch for runtime kernel mismatch logs (we had one last month).

maria: I'm inclined to run the autofix and rebuild. I'll kick it off now and report back. If rebuild doesn't finish in 35m, we fallback to sidecar + customer-notify.

packaging-bot: Trigger received: ./tools/release-lint --require-tags security-policy,installer --autofix. Job id: pkg-1798610000-1. ETA 22-28m.

sam: Ops, if Maria signs the new bundle, will deploy-bot automatically pick up new tag or do we need manual `release: new-bundle`?

deploy-bot: Manual ping required. Post `release: new-bundle 1.4.3` in this thread after escrow upload and I will reassign canary window. Current lock TTL: 45 minutes.

maria: (18m later) autofix applied, small wording change and added missing security-policy tag. Rebuilding installer now. Running installer-smoke locally.

maria: smoke test: ./scripts/installer-smoke --bundle dist/installer-1.4.3.tar.gz -> basic install + systemd unit up + health-checks passed. No regressions in unit tests.

maria: Uploading artifact to escrow and cosign-signing now. Using cosign key id packaging-key-1. Confirming key TTL with ops.

ops: Confirmed cosign key TTL 48h, signer agent has RW to s3://redwood-escrow/private/1.4.3/. Creating metadata file installer-1.4.3.tar.gz.sha256.asc and cosign attestation installer-1.4.3.cosign.json

ops: Escrow upload complete. Path: s3://redwood-escrow/private/1.4.3/installer-1.4.3.tar.gz and attestations under same prefix. All checksums match local build.

maria: Posted `release: new-bundle 1.4.3` to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Received `release: new-bundle 1.4.3` from maria. Canary allocation updated. Canaries scheduled: 22:00-22:20. Monitor channels: eng-oncall, eng-sre, incidents.

jordan: Maria, please add a short changelog note: 'docs: fix release-notes tags; no functional changes'. Mark as 'metadata-only'. Elaine, please confirm customer notification for acme-corp & healthco since they require embedded notes. We rebuilt so embed satisfied?

elaine: Confirmed: since artifact was rebuilt with embedded release_notes.md that includes `security-policy` tag, contractual obligations are met. No outbound customer notification required beyond normal release notes email.

rei: I'll watch canary telemetry. If error_rate >2% or median latency regresses >100ms within first 10m, I'll call rollback. Also escalations if KV warmup miss rate >12% after first 5m.

ben: I'll monitor cosign attestations and escrow checksum every 2 minutes during canary. If mismatch, emergency unpin and rollback.

ops: Lock TTL will be released after full rollout or on manual abort. If rollback occurs, we will re-pin 1.4.2 and publish a rollback notice.

maria: Thanks team. Releasing to canary at 22:00Z. If anyone wants to add additional checks, say now.

sam: Add one small check: runtime trace sampler should show successful KV cache warm path within first 3 traces post-start; if not, abort.

rei: Added to live checklist. I'll start alerting rule watch now.

maria: Closing thread for now. Will post canary status in 10 minutes after window start. :rocket:
